A '''warship''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] participated in the [[Battle of Corellia]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was heavily damaged during the battle. It clipped a [[Unidentified Coronet high-rise|high-rise tower]] in Corellia's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], collapsing several floors and nearly toppling the entire tower.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial warship was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the [[Beharen Droid Factory]]<ref name="Codex" /> in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
